g.title: AgentLedger360_OPM
g.text: Every process carries its implementing module. Tags like [R2 R5] bind a process to the rules table. Read SD first, then follow the dashed "in-zoomed in" edges.

g.title: cluster_SD4
g.text: docs/TEAM_PLAN.md - two laptops, one contract, one gate

g.title: cluster_rules
g.text: tags like [R2 R5] on a process = rules it must obey; OPL + tests in OPM_GUIDE.md

g.title: rules_table
g.text: LLM agents choose actions and propose rulings; deterministic tools/policy authorize every money move; a ruling counts only inside the policy band
Money = integer minor units; every ledger txn sums to 0; only treasury may go negative
State change + outbox event in ONE transaction (BEGIN IMMEDIATE)
Order status changes only via compare-and-set along the SD1/SD2 state graph
Idempotency: hold by idempotency_key; buyer funded once; receipt redeemed once
Spend mandate (max/order, daily) checked before debit; survival tier caps price
Seller executes the QUOTED task; verifies HMAC receipt, amount, quote ownership; HMAC-signs content_hash (platform verifies before the delivery transition)
Adjudicator trusts nobody: re-hash evidence, re-run acceptance checks
all pass -> RELEASE; critical fail -> REFUND_FULL; only performance fail -> REFUND_PARTIAL 50%
Point-in-time: rows <= as_of; synthetic path fixed-length; seeds via zlib.crc32, never hash()
Warehouse built only from events; dedupe by event_id; marts rebuilt idempotently
DQ checks = 0 violations (incl. AI cost and the audit chain); escrow == open orders; OLTP orders == fact_orders
Python 3.11 AND 3.13: no PEP 695, no sqlite autocommit=, ISO timestamps; gate green before merge
Frontend calls backend only via api.js; money via fmt.usd; status = colour + icon + label
contracts.py + sql/001_core.sql are frozen: change only with both devs, then update OPM + guide
Every LLM call is metered (tokens, integer micro-USD, price source); runs stop at the tool-call or cost budget; trace + events persist in one txn
Grounding: agent reports may only cite tool results; guardian must cite checks that failed; undecided deliveries are closed by policy
Capability switches: open funding off unless flagged or operator-token; hold refused while paused or above the global cap
Each outbox event extends a hash chain in the same transaction; verify_audit_chain detects a rewritten payload
Public rounds: optional run token, one start per IP per minute, daily AI budget degrades the round to the rule agent
Private outline doc never leaves the laptop; no SAP product integration claimed
